get.summary: Stream the events of a Session

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The sequence of the last Session event the client received (an EventSource sends it on reconnect): the stream replays the events after it. The same cursor as `after`; when both are present they must be equal. Answers `400 SESSION_CURSOR_INVALID` when repeated, not equal to `after`, not a non-negative integer or beyond the latest event. An empty value reads as `0` (replay of every retained event). Without either, the stream starts at the latest event.

200.description: Server-sent events of the Session: `session-change` events whose `id` is the event sequence and whose `data` is the JSON Session event, and `resync-required` when the client must read the Session again. Replay starts after `after` or `Last-Event-ID`; comment lines keep the connection alive.
